question: Which of the following is the common name of a natural admixture mineral of zinc carbonate and hydrous zinc silicate?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Calamine**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**__Calamine:__**

__
 
• A natural **admixture mineral of Zinc carbonate and hydrous Zinc silicate.**
 
• Because the two ores are very similar and often occur together, the name calamine was given to the mixture but also incorrectly used for the separate minerals.
 
• To differentiate the minerals, they were given new names of:
 
 
• **smithsonite(zinc carbonate)**
 
• **Hemimorphite (hydrous zinc silicate).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Borax: **__(6sodium borate/sodium tetraborate/ disodium tetraborate)

 __
 
• It is used as a **household cleaner** and a booster for **laundry detergent.**
 
 
 
• **Chalk:**__
 __
 
• It is a **soft, white, porous, sedimentary carbonate rock.**
 
• Chalk is a form of limestone composed of the mineral calcite and originally formed deep under the sea
 
• Formed by the **compression of microscopic plankton that had settled to the sea floor**.
 
 
 
• **Benzol(aka benzene):**__
 
 
• It is a **crude form of benzene, containing toluene, xylene, and other hydrocarbons**
 
• It is obtained from **coal tar or coal gas and used as a fuel**
